title: Speculative enquiry: graduate site or project engineer (Derrimut)
rationale: Western Civil is a Derrimut civil contractor whose land development team self-performs earthworks, bound and unbound pavements, stormwater drainage and culverts on industrial and residential subdivisions, matching Marc's Advanced Diploma road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design.

Its careers page explicitly invites expressions of interest from undergraduate and graduate engineers and site and project engineers, which fits Marc's Philippines field engineer and project-in-charge site work.
Derrimut is about 25 minutes from Melton; Marc has a licence and own transport.
caution: Speculative: no advertised vacancy, expression of interest only. No Australian construction site experience yet; site work was in the Philippines 2019 to 2020.
gaps: No paid civil design role yet
apply_instructions: Careers page: send your resume to projects@western-civil.com.au with the subject 'Career Opportunity'.
